mandatory_gates_in_order: capture identity, registration, exact encoded/source timing, zero timestamp/missing/extra/duration errors, and immutable input-only selection manifest are verified
deduplicate by video_frame_index; conflicting observations for one source image abort all classification
candidate is a maximal nonempty main_arrows ambiguous run inside one predeclared input-only sequence event; unreadable is never an arrow phase edge
two source-consecutive readable support frames immediately precede and two immediately follow the run; each side has one stable endpoint value
every neighboring video_frame_index and source_frame_seq increments by exactly one, capture_ns strictly increases, and each gap is at most the verified capture maximum source interval
nearest endpoint span is at most 96000000 + verified capture maximum source interval nanoseconds
the resolved main-arrow expectation is identical throughout the support chain and is exactly the two endpoint phase sets
endpoint arrow sets differ by exactly one direction
nearest endpoint and same-side support direction states are definite and agree with their readable arrow-set values
every run frame is ambiguous solely because the changed direction is partial or faint; every extra direction stays in its endpoint definite state
all profiles contain 16 finite values in [0,255] with the same 4x4 schema and direction reference bounds
changed-direction separation S between the two fixed outer support profiles is at least 52.0; there is no fallback or anchor search
every interior changed-direction profile, including the nearest readable frames on both sides of the refusal, has -0.05 <= alpha <= 1.05 and rho <= 0.15
the alpha sequence including endpoints has no backward step above 0.05 and total backward motion at most 0.10
each extra direction has profile diameter RMS at most 8.0 across the full support chain
raw observations remain unchanged; the qualified record affects main_arrows only and is honored only when classifier_id is explicitly policy-listed
numeric_comparison: Use unrounded float64 metrics for inclusive comparisons. Round only retained display diagnostics.

profile.sample: float64 from retained max-channel cell medians rounded by reader to 0.01

scope.claim: the whole fixed support chain follows a coherent path between two expressly permitted arrow phases; only its maximal raw ambiguous run is classified and no individual ambiguous frame is assigned an endpoint value
